# Status {.unnumbered}

Every section of the report is now written, so this render contains the whole report after this note. Build tickets #23 (scaffold, contract pipeline and CI) and #24 (data fetch, weights and YuNet detection) laid the foundations, and #25 added the dataset analysis behind Section 2 and the minimum usable face size it fixes. #26 measured every recognition model on LFW, and #27 rehearsed the watchlist on CelebA, froze each model's threshold and chose the first active model. #28 compared learning on embeddings with the best-photo rule, put the mean rule live for two models, broke every model's rates down by group and wrote the learned decision rule. #29, #30 and #31 built the prototype's watchlist, live monitor, and sightings, removal and purge. #49 measured the same-person threshold and smaller watchlists, #51 set out what purge cannot erase and #52 recorded the LFW test the first active model rule applies. #32 wrote the remaining sections: the problem and its ethics, the pipeline, models and protocol, the implementation, Section 5.1's table and ROC, confirmation and purge, the prototype, the rest of the limitations and the reproduction appendix.
